name: Partner percent resolved zero/null - no discount applied
expected: Partner deal (Deal_Type__c != 'Fortra Originated') where resolved PartnerDiscountPercent is null or not >0: Partner Percent Resolved Filter (Deal_Type!='Fortra Originated' AND PartnerDiscountPercent IsNotNull AND GreaterThan 0) NEGATIVE branch -> no partner discount applied; NetUnitPrice unchanged at list.
actual: Existing synced partner quote 00734224 (Deal_Type__c='Distributor - Fortra Originated' -> NotEquals 'Fortra Originated' TRUE, so partner block ENTERED; PartnerAccountId=AB Test, Partner_Pricing_Model='Discount') Force-repriced through V21 (isSuccess=true, errorResponse:[]). Line 'Unlimited Classification' (Subscription, list 250 USD): prehook resolved PartnerDiscountPercent=NULL -> Partner Percent Resolved Filter fails (IsNotNull FALSE) -> NetUnitPrice=250=ListPrice=Pre_Partner_Price__c=250=Base_Price__c=250, NetTotalPrice=250, TotalLineAmount=250 (net unchanged at list, fully hydrated, NOT a $0 artifact). POSITIVE CONTROL (existing UI quote 00780845, AB Test PPM-00028 Subscription%=18) repriced to NetUnitPrice=list*0.82 (Automate Professional 2400->1968; Additional Threat Assessments 10000->8200, pct=18) -> proves the discount DOES apply when pct>0, so the null case genuinely differs.
evidence: NEG (E-08): https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Quote/0Q0WC000002dr050AA/view (#00734224, QLI 0QLWC000002ykbV4AQ net=250=list, PartnerDiscountPercent=null, Pre_Partner_Price=250) ; reprice log Data/pricing-v21-validation/e08/body_734224.json (isSuccess=true). POSITIVE CONTROL: https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Quote/0Q0WC000003507J0AQ/view (#00780845, pct=18 net=list*0.82). Live V21 metadata trace: Data/pricing-v21-validation/e08/retrieve (ExpressionSetDefinition V21 9QBWC0000000oWH4AY) Partner Percent Resolved Filter line 84598-84629 (conditionLogic '1 AND 2 AND 3' = Deal_Type NotEquals 'Fortra Originated' / PartnerDiscountPercent IsNotNull / PartnerDiscountPercent GreaterThan 0); PartnerDiscount13 ManualDiscount line 2793-2877 (AdjustmentValue=PartnerDiscountPercent applied to InputUnitPrice -> NetUnitPrice).
notes: Negative branch of E-02/E-03 partner-pricing. V21 mechanism (live retrieve): Partner Percent Resolved Filter (AdvancedListFilter, parentStep ResolvePartnerDiscountPercent) gates on Deal_Type!='Fortra Originated' AND PartnerDiscountPercent IsNotNull AND >0; when null/0 the resolve/audit does NOT record a discount and the ManualDiscount (PartnerDiscount13, AdjustmentValue=PartnerDiscountPercent) yields a 0% adjustment so net=list. Empirically confirmed on hydrated existing line 00734224 (pct=null -> net=250=list) with the positive control 00780845 (pct=18 -> net=list*0.82) demonstrating the discount IS applied when pct>0. SC-3359 (One-Time/Perpetual partner net-not-applied, E-03 FAIL) is a DISTINCT positive-branch defect and does NOT touch the null/0 negative branch tested here. HARNESS NOTE: fresh Apex-inserted fixtures could not be used as primary evidence -- (a) the headless place(Force) API drops freshly-inserted unsynced Subscription lines and zeroes unhydrated Perpetual lines (the documented base-seed gap, also hit by E-01/E-02/E-03), and (b) the partner-percent prehook does NOT re-resolve PartnerDiscountPercent on a headless partner-swap of an already-stamped line; so I validated on an existing UI-built, synced, hydrated partner quote where the prehook had already resolved null. Fixture scripts/apex/setupE08PartnerNullPercentTestData.compact.apex (BoKS IAM null-bucket partner PPM-00029) demonstrates the intended config edge but its lines hit the harness line-drop, so it is documented not asserted.
verdict_reason: On a real hydrated partner-deal line (Deal_Type != 'Fortra Originated') where PartnerDiscountPercent resolved to null, V21's Partner Percent Resolved Filter negative branch left NetUnitPrice=250=list (matching expected), while the positive control with pct=18 correctly netted list*0.82 -- so the null/0 case applies no discount exactly as specified.
